# Peanut Butter Toast

**⚠️ Allergens**: nuts / gluten
**🕐 Cooking Time**: 5 minutes
**👥 Servings**: 2

## Ingredients
- Bread: 100 grams
- Peanut Butter: 2 tbsp

## Instructions
1. Toast the bread to your desired level of crispiness.
2. Spread 1 tbsp of peanut butter evenly over each slice of toasted bread.
3. Serve immediately.

## Safety Notes
- Be careful when handling the hot toaster or toasted bread to avoid burns.
